purpose: Eighth independently reviewed batch. Each fact is supported by a continuous quotation from a current first-party airline page or first-party contract. A conditional channel is a documented policy route, never availability or final carriage acceptance.

provenance_defaults.reviewer: Codex — direct reading of official airline page

facts.condition_scope: Live dogs and cats are accepted as special cargo only on listed domestic routes and aircraft, with advance booking, health certificate, kennel, breed and capacity restrictions; international stations are excluded.
facts.finder_effect: Bangkok Airways cargo is conditional and domestic-route-only.
facts.quote: Special cargo service as Live animals dog, cat (AVI) is available on Airbus and ATR72 on the following routes:
facts.locator: Cargo Service → Pet Carriage Service

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet dogs are not accepted in the passenger cabin; guide dogs are a separate exception.
facts.finder_effect: China Southern cabin is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: No animal can be brought into the passenger cabin
facts.locator: Pets → Which animals can be brought into the cabin?

facts.condition_scope: Pets may be checked only after prior airline and successive-carrier approval, with quarantine, vaccination, route, document and container requirements.
facts.finder_effect: China Southern hold is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: you can check it
facts.locator: Pets → May I take my pet into cabin?

facts.condition_scope: Small dogs and cats up to 10 kg including the container; Main Cabin only, advance reservation, route, age, container, quota and documentation restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: Copa cabin is conditional with a 10 kg combined pet-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: Copa Airlines only accepts small dogs and cats (maximum 10kg including container) as pets in the cabin.
facts.locator: COM-24-001 → Policy

facts.condition_scope: Copa no longer accepts pets as passenger checked baggage on domestic or international flights; Copa Cargo is a separate route.
facts.finder_effect: Copa passenger hold is a documented refusal; do not confuse it with Copa Cargo.
facts.quote: shall no longer offer any transportation services for pets as checked baggage
facts.locator: Contract of Carriage → 5.7.1.1 Transportation of Pets as Checked Baggage

facts.condition_scope: Pet transport outside the passenger cabin must be arranged through Copa Cargo; cargo booking, station, route, animal, crate and documentation approval apply.
facts.finder_effect: Copa cargo is the documented conditional alternative to checked-pet service.
facts.quote: must be arranged through Copa Cargo
facts.locator: Contract of Carriage → 5.7.1.1 Transportation of Pets as Checked Baggage

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pets are not carried on IndiGo aircraft; the separately stated guide-dog exception is outside this verdict.
facts.finder_effect: IndiGo cabin is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: does not permit the carriage of pets
facts.locator: How to Book → Special Services → Can I carry my pet on board?

facts.condition_scope: The official prohibition covers carriage of ordinary pets on IndiGo aircraft; guide dogs are a separate exception.
facts.finder_effect: IndiGo passenger hold is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: does not permit the carriage of pets or animals
facts.locator: How to Book → Special Services → Can I carry my pet on board?

facts.condition_scope: The first-party passenger policy states that pets or animals are not carried on IndiGo aircraft; no ordinary-pet cargo exception is stated there.
facts.finder_effect: IndiGo cargo is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs under the reviewed policy.
facts.quote: pets or animals on its aircraft
facts.locator: How to Book → Special Services → Can I carry my pet on board?

facts.condition_scope: Ordinary pet dogs are generally not permitted in cabin; trained service dogs under the separately stated conditions are outside this verdict.
facts.finder_effect: Thai Airways cabin is a documented refusal for ordinary pet dogs.
facts.quote: As a general policy, we do not accept pets in the cabin for travel, except for the conditions listed above.
facts.locator: Pets in Cabin Policy → Pets Other than Service Animals

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats as accompanied checked baggage on the same flight, subject to age, breed embargo, route, aircraft, crate, document, weight and advance-acceptance conditions.
facts.finder_effect: Thai Airways hold is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: accept dog/cat for carriage as checked baggage
facts.locator: Pets as Checked Baggage (AVIH) → Conditions for Acceptance

facts.condition_scope: Cargo acceptance requires direct coordination with Thai Cargo and remains subject to station, route, breed, crate and documentation approval.
facts.finder_effect: Thai Airways cargo is a documented conditional route, not guaranteed acceptance.
facts.quote: For cargo acceptance of pets, please contact the Cargo Department directly.
facts.locator: Pets as Checked Baggage (AVIH) → Pets in Cargo

facts.condition_scope: Dogs up to 8 kg including container and food may be accepted in cabin, subject to prior carrier agreement, route, container and documentation rules.
facts.finder_effect: Tunisair cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-container-food ceiling.
facts.quote: les chiens d’un poids maximal de 08 kg y compris le contenant et la nourriture
facts.locator: Conditions générales de transport → 10.2.1 Animaux voyageant en cabine

facts.condition_scope: The conditions of carriage contain a dedicated hold policy and require prior carrier agreement, a safe crate and complete documents; final method and count remain at the carrier's discretion.
facts.finder_effect: Tunisair hold is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: Animaux voyageant en soute
facts.locator: Conditions générales de transport → 10.3 Animaux voyageant en soute

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 8 kg including the carrier; aircraft, route, booking, health, quota, container and documentation restrictions apply.
facts.finder_effect: SKY express cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing up to 8 kg
facts.locator: Carriage of animals in the cabin (up to 8kg)

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats over 8 kg and no more than 25 kg including the crate; ATR aircraft only, with route, booking, health, crate and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: SKY express hold is conditional, aircraft-scoped and has a 25 kg combined ceiling.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing more than 8 kilograms
facts.locator: Transporting animals in the aircraft hold (weight more than 8kg)

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 10 kg including carrier, subject to direct-route, United Kingdom, age, quota, advance booking, container and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: KM Malta cabin is conditional with a 10 kg combined animal-and-carrier ceiling.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats (up to 10kg)
facts.locator: Travelling with Pets → Pets in Cabin

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 32 kg, subject to direct-route, United Kingdom, quota, advance booking, crate and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: KM Malta hold is a documented conditional route with a 32 kg stated ceiling.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing up to 32kg
facts.locator: Travelling with Pets → Pet as Checked Baggage

facts.condition_scope: Cargo may be booked when PETC or accompanied baggage is unavailable; route, station, crate, documentation and cargo-department approval apply.
facts.finder_effect: KM Malta cargo is a documented conditional alternative.
facts.quote: booking your pet in the aircraft hold as Cargo
facts.locator: Travelling with Pets → Pets as Cargo

facts.condition_scope: One dog or cat up to 8 kg including the container per passenger, subject to quota, advance confirmation, route, container and documentation rules.
facts.finder_effect: SunExpress cabin is conditional with an 8 kg combined animal-and-container ceiling.
facts.quote: one dog or cat weighing up to 8 kg (incl. container)
facts.locator: Transporting animals → Carriage of animals inside cabin

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats over 8 kg, subject to advance confirmation, route, aircraft, crate, health and documentation rules.
facts.finder_effect: SunExpress hold is a documented conditional route.
facts.quote: Dogs and cats weighing more than 8 kg
facts.locator: Transporting animals → Travelling in the animal compartment

facts.condition_scope: Dogs and cats up to 8 kg including the crate, subject to prior approval, route, operating carrier, quota, container, health and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: Smartwings cabin is a documented conditional route with an 8 kg combined ceiling.
facts.quote: Pet in cabin (1 piece up to 8 kg / leg)
facts.locator: Fees and charges → Price list of additional services → PETC

facts.condition_scope: Animal in hold up to 32 kg including the box, subject to prior approval, route, operating carrier, aircraft, capacity, container, health and documentation restrictions.
facts.finder_effect: Smartwings hold is a documented conditional route with a 32 kg combined ceiling.
facts.quote: Animal in hold (1 piece up to 32 kg / leg)
facts.locator: Fees and charges → Price list of additional services → AVIH

intentionally_unset.reason: The reviewed first-party page establishes a special cargo service only; it does not prove a passenger-cabin policy.
The reviewed page uses cargo terminology and shipment conditions, not accompanied checked-pet service.
The reviewed FAQ establishes cabin refusal and checked-pet transport, not a separate unaccompanied freight offer.
The reviewed conditions establish passenger cabin and a dedicated hold procedure but no distinct ordinary-dog freight offer.
The reviewed passenger page establishes cabin and aircraft hold only, not separately booked freight.
The reviewed page establishes cabin and accompanied hold. Route-specific air-cargo language elsewhere is insufficient for a general cargo answer.
The reviewed price list establishes PETC and AVIH only. A route-specific Dubai cargo rule is not a general network-wide cargo answer.
